figures.caption: Figure 1: Comparison of deep research report paradigms. Text-centric systems omit visual evidence, while chart-generation systems synthesize plots but lose source figures. ViDR retrieves and grounds source figures in the report, generating analytical charts only when source evidence is insufficient.
Figure 3: Domain distribution of the 160 research queries in MMR Bench+, spanning 16 domains across science, technology, policy, and public affairs.

Figure 4: An excerpt from a report generated by ViDR. The report interleaves retrieved source figures with textual analysis, demonstrating fine grained alignment between visual evidence and report statements.

Table 1: Main results on MMR Bench+. Higher is better. Abbreviations: DR = DeepResearch; MMDR = Multimodal DeepResearcher; Info. = Informativeness; Coher. = Coherence; Verif. = Verifiability; Viz.Q. = Visualization Quality; Src.Fig. = Source-Figure Integration; Ovrl. = Overall. Open source baselines use the backbone model shown in parentheses when applicable.

Table 4: Human evaluation of LLM-as-judge scores. Three annotators judge whether each automatic score and rationale is reasonable, partially reasonable, or unreasonable for each evaluation dimension. Accept. = Reason. + Part. Reason.
